goal: Grow email newsletter signups ahead of a new running shoe launch

query: Grow email newsletter signups ahead of a new running shoe launch

hypothesis: Highlighting Allbirds' natural, sustainable materials (wool, tree fiber, sugarcane) and comfort-focused design in newsletter content will drive higher email signups from runners and walkers who prioritize comfort and materials, especially when paired with social proof and early-access incentives for the new running shoe launch.

calls.reason: Find past campaign evidence on what messaging and incentives drove newsletter signups for Allbirds product launches, especially around materials and comfort.
Measure which content types (materials-focused, comfort-focused, launch teasers) and platforms (Newsletter, X) historically drove the highest signup conversion rates for Allbirds.
Identify what Allbirds-related content resonates with technical/early-adopter audiences on Hacker News, especially around materials innovation and product launches.
Review which claims about Allbirds' materials, comfort, or launch details failed verification in the last campaign to avoid repeating unsupported promises.
Understand the verification risk profile for claims about natural materials, comfort, sustainability, and launch timelines to ensure only supported claims are used.
Review the prior campaign's editorial score (94/100), fact/check patterns, and gaps to build on strengths and avoid past claim pitfalls.

sql: SELECT evidence_id, heading, excerpt FROM lightning.metastore.flusso.brand_evidence.evidence_section WHERE domain = 'allbirds.com' AND (lower(excerpt) LIKE '%allbirds newsletter signups%' OR lower(excerpt) LIKE '%running shoe launch email%' OR lower(excerpt) LIKE '%natural materials comfort%' OR lower(excerpt) LIKE '%early access waitlist%') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT platform, asset_type, count(*) AS assets, sum(impressions) AS impressions, sum(engagements) AS engagements, sum(clicks) AS clicks, sum(conversions) AS conversions FROM lightning.metastore.flusso.brand_evidence.performance WHERE domain = 'allbirds.com' GROUP BY platform, asset_type ORDER BY engagements DESC

CREATE REST SESSION TABLE fl_hn_liveallbirdsnews REQUEST (endpoint "https://hn.algolia.com/api/v1/search?query=allbirds.com&tags=story&hitsPerPage=50", method "GET", http_encoding "URLENCODED", response_type "JSON", insecure_ssl "false") HEADER ("User-Agent" "Flusso/0.3 (evidence agent)") BODY ()

SELECT h.title, h.points, h.num_comments, substr(h.created_at, 1, 10) AS created, h.url FROM session.fl_hn_liveallbirdsnews LATERAL VIEW explode(hits) AS h WHERE h.url LIKE '%allbirds.com%' ORDER BY h.points DESC LIMIT 12

sql: SELECT claim_kind, status, resolution_status, claim_text, recommendation, created_at FROM lightning.metastore.flusso.brand_evidence.claim_outcome WHERE domain = 'allbirds.com' AND status IN ('unsupported', 'conflict') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 12

sql: SELECT o.claim_kind, o.status, count(*) AS claims, sum(CASE WHEN o.resolution_status = 'repaired' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repaired FROM lightning.metastore.flusso.brand_evidence.claim_outcome o JOIN lightning.metastore.flusso.brand_evidence.campaign c ON o.campaign_id = c.campaign_id WHERE c.domain = 'allbirds.com' GROUP BY o.claim_kind, o.status ORDER BY claims DESC
